title: Pure Artifact
summary: Artifact cards only, with generic Rank 5s, Links and staples. Artifacts are Level 5 LIGHT Fairies that you Set in the Spell & Trap Zone. When a Set Artifact is destroyed there on the opponent's turn, it summons itself and usually does something on arrival. Artifact Moralltach destroys a face-up card, Artifact Failnaught Sets another Artifact from the GY, and Artifact Caduceus draws for each one. You do the destroying yourself: Artifact Ignition destroys a Spell/Trap and Sets an Artifact from the Deck. Artifact Beagalltach and Artifact Vajra destroy your own Set cards when they arrive. Two Artifacts then make a Rank 5 on the opponent's turn through Artifacts Unleashed. Artifact Dagda, the newest card (2020), Sets an Artifact from the hand or Deck whenever another card's effect activates. Artifact Scythe and Artifact Mjollnir are Forbidden.
main: Artifact Moralltach
Destroys a face-up card when it arrives on their turn.
Artifact Beagalltach
Destroys up to two of your Set cards when it arrives, setting off more Artifacts.
Artifact Failnaught
Sets an Artifact from the GY when it arrives.
Artifact Lancea
Tributes from the hand on their turn to stop all banishing.
Artifact Vajra
Destroys all your Spell/Trap Zone cards when it arrives; stops a direct attack.
Artifact Caduceus
Draws each time an Artifact arrives on their turn.
Artifact Labrys
Summons itself from the hand when an Artifact is destroyed.
Artifact Chakram
Summons itself from the hand when your Spells/Traps would be destroyed.
Artifact Aegis
Protects your Artifacts from their effects when it arrives.
Artifact Achilleshield
Stops attacks on your Artifacts when it arrives.
Artifact Ignition
Quick-Play: destroys a Spell/Trap and Sets an Artifact from the Deck.
Artifacts Unleashed
Xyz Summons with two Artifacts on either turn.
Artifact Sanctum
Summons an Artifact from the Deck; destroys a card if they destroy it.
